name: Mavenir
description: Mavenir provides cloud-native signaling and telecom software solutions for SS7, IMS, and 5G core networks across European carriers.
strengths: Established presence with major European telecom operators including tier-1 carriers
Comprehensive cloud-native architecture with strong 5G and IMS portfolio
Extensive partnerships and integration capabilities with existing telecom infrastructure
weaknesses: Higher deployment complexity and longer implementation timelines compared to Skyvera's streamlined solutions
Premium pricing model may limit adoption among mid-market carriers like Odido
Less agile in rapid feature deployment for legacy SS7 modernization scenarios

name: Ulticom
description: Ulticom specializes in signaling software and protocol testing solutions for SS7, Diameter, and IMS networks serving European telecommunications operators.
strengths: Deep expertise in SS7 protocol and legacy network modernization
Strong reputation in signaling layer testing and validation for interoperability
Established customer base among regional and mid-market European carriers
weaknesses: Limited next-generation signaling capabilities and slower innovation in 5G-era solutions
Smaller engineering team reduces ability to compete on feature velocity versus Skyvera
Less comprehensive IMS and modern telecom stack integration compared to competitors
